name: Counterweight trebuchet
description: A counterweight trebuchet (the user's own model; CC0 textures). Crew it from either side (Aim): turn the frame slowly with the aim, set the throw with the elevation (about 45 to 215 m; 105 m at the middle), Fire knocks out the trigger: the arm swings and the sling looses the stone on a high arc; it crushes what it lands on (area damage) and breaches rampart bays like round shot. The crew winches the arm back down and loads the next stone (about 8 s). Twenty stones. Emplaced: it is not moved. Game values.

station.label: Trebuchet
station.note: TRE1 / TRE2: the model's one timeline (tools/trebuchet/timeline.py --time 0.8: the 21:04 export keeps 30 fps frames on a 24 fps timebase): fire 0..7.47 s, the release 1.17 s in, reload 7.5..15.47 s (the stone back in the pouch 7.57 s in). The stone leaves the sling at 40 deg; the elevation sets its speed: -5 deg 20 m/s, 0 deg 30 m/s (the user's approved shot), +15 deg 45 m/s. A 0.34 m stone, 300 damage within 5 m, breaches rampart bays (WALL_CANNON); twenty stones; worked from either side (gunner / gunner2, the nearer one); the frame turns 3 deg/s in place.
